description: DBEngine.CreateDatabase(path, ";LANGID=0x0409;CP=1252;COUNTRY=0", 64) in a MDB file (General, LANGID 0x0409, Jet 4 MDB); reads DBEngine.Version, the database Version and CollatingOrder, DBEngine.Errors. If it is created: table T(ID Long primary key, K TEXT(40)) holds 54 designed values (case, accent, expansion, spacing, punctuation, digit, kana and Han pairs, then two Null and two empty values) as exact BSTR units through a table-type recordset; indexes IX_K (K) then IX_KD (K DESC) are built after the rows; T0 holds the same rows with no index. UQ and UQD have a unique index on K and on K DESC and receive one INSERT..SELECT per row, so every refusal is recorded. Whole-file images are kept after the rows and after each index build. Then reads, in the same session, T with no Index and by IX_K forward and backward and IX_KD forward; SQL ORDER BY K, ORDER BY K DESC, ORDER BY K then ID, and GROUP BY K; Seek = and >= with every distinct pair-corpus value on IX_K; four LIKE prefix and class patterns; the IDs surviving in UQ, and the UX_K walk. Asks whether CreateDatabase accepts this locale and version, which public order, equality classes and unique-index classes result, and what the files look like after each step.
